title: Playboy Magazine September 2007 Complete With Centerfold Jamie Pressly
descriptionText: The product is a complete issue of Playboy Magazine from September 2007, featuring an illustrated centerfold of Jamie Pressly. Published by American Media Inc, this English-language magazine is known for its content focusing on women, art, and photography. With a monthly publication frequency and a volume of 54, this issue includes topics such as photography, art, and modeling, making it a sought-after collectible for fans of vintage magazines.
